test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 07
subject: general
question: 'SWAYAM' is a portal initiated by:
solution:
The correct answer is__** MHRD**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• SWAYAM (Study Webs of Active–Learning for Young Aspiring Minds) focuses on the access, equity, and quality of Education Policy.
 
• Its objective is to bring the best teaching and learning experience along with the resources to all, including the most disadvantaged in society.
 
• The use of indigenous developed IT platform facilitates hosting courses from the elite educational institutions in the country by anyone, anytime.
 
• The courses are available free of cost.
 
• SWAYAM portal has been developed by the Ministry of Human Resource Development along with NPTEL, IIT Madras, with inputs from Google Inc. and Persistent Systems Ltd.
 
• The courses are from Class 9th to post-graduation.
 
• Certification at the end of the course with a little fee is also provided.
 
• An assessment of the student at the end of the course through an exam and marks obtained in the same is a feature of SWAYAM.
 
• UGC has passed the UGC Regulation 2016 advising the universities in the country to identify courses.

**Thus, 'SWAYAM' is a portal initiated by MHRD.**__
